intent.proves: At least one language-layer page has a menu text different from its master page.
intent.scope: non-deleted pages on language layers with a resolvable master page

bindings.reason: Requires paging through every unit per area and a comparison with the master; handler not implemented.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Page p JOIN Page m ON m.PageId = p.PageMasterPageId WHERE p.PageDeleted = 0 AND m.PageDeleted = 0 AND ISNULL(p.PageMasterPageId, 0) > 0 AND ISNULL(p.PageMenuText, N'') <> ISNULL(m.PageMenuText, N'')
